name: Pride take page renders a seven-point bipolar scale
description: The Pride assessment take page loads at question 1 of 36 with a seven-point bipolar answer scale (two pole labels), like Solstice.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Pride take page
Verify the progress indicator reads '1 of 36' and the first question prompt is shown with a seven-point numbered answer scale (options numbered 1 through 7).
Click the number 4 option to answer the first question
Verify the progress indicator reads '2 of 36'.
